questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to “begin”?
questions.explanation: Begin and start have the same basic meaning.

questions.question: Which word means “a short trip for pleasure”?
questions.explanation: A journey can be a trip from one place to another; in this context it is a short trip for pleasure.

questions.question: What is the opposite of “cheap”?
questions.explanation: The opposite of cheap is expensive.

questions.question: Which word means “to look after someone or something”?
questions.explanation: Care for means to look after someone or something.

questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to “quick”?
questions.explanation: Quick and fast have the same basic meaning.
